title_sq: APARTAMENT PER SHITJE TEK VILA L !

title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE AT VILA L!
description_en: We have for sale an apartment in the area of ​​Astir at Vila L. It is suitable for 1+1 and 2 bathrooms, but it can easily be returned to the initial condition of 2+1+2. The apartment is organized in a living room with a shared kitchen, 1 bedroom, 2 bathrooms, one of which is in the master bedroom and a spacious balcony. It is offered furnished as in the photo, with a contemporary furnishing that includes suspended ceilings, ground air conditioners, hood system, incaso toilets, appliances of prestigious brands, etc. The building is equipped with an elevator and regular maintenance. Ideal for residence or investment. Orientation south-west Possibility of parking at an extra price. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
